items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: But Trane was playing on some of the things that he heard the way he put them scales together. I got a good idea how he put all that together.

ctx.x: Where did that inspiration for that kind of playing come from? Do you have any idea?

I haven’t the slightest idea, well Trane heard everything. And he heard that the saxophone, like you heard that tune that he did at the Olatunji Center with he and Pharaoh Sanders, that live date that they did at Olatunji Center? I mean that was a hell of a date. I mean they were completely out on that. But Trane was playing on some of the things that he heard the way he put them scales together.
